name: LOCAL Improvement Landing
description: How to land a LOCAL-level (operator-specific) improvement: persist to Firestore or commit confined to the operator/ overlay, and never open an upstream PR.
author: architect-prime
when_to_use: When landing a LOCAL-tier improvement (operator project context, memory content, or operator/ processes). Defines the Firestore/overlay landing and the no-upstream rule. Never use for generic platform changes.
